errors.profile_remove_failed: Saglabāto pieteikšanos neizdevās noņemt. Aizveriet pieteikšanās logu un mēģiniet vēlreiz.
errors.unsupported_platform: Pieteikšanās pārlūkā šajā platformā nav pieejama. Izmantojiet pieejamu atslēgas metodi.

connections.kimiHelperHelp: Pirmajā pieteikšanās reizē lietotne lejupielādē oficiālo Kimi palīgrīku tieši no Kimi. Tas darbojas lokāli; panelis nesūta telemetriju.

mobilePrototype.title: Open on your phone
mobilePrototype.intro: Scan the QR code once and connect your phone. This prototype uses only your local network.
mobilePrototype.httpWarning: Tikai uzticami tīkli: šī adrese izmanto nešifrētu HTTP. Izvairieties no publiskiem un viesu tīkliem.
mobilePrototype.save: After connecting, save the dashboard to your home screen.
mobilePrototype.remote: The Wi-Fi dashboard works without Tailscale. Phone push needs a trusted HTTPS address and a running computer with internet access. You can use your own domain and certificate, or optionally a private Tailscale HTTPS address. On iPhone, save that HTTPS address to the Home Screen, open its icon and allow notifications once. No dashboard relay is operated by us.
mobilePrototype.offline: No installation is reachable. Start a paired app on the same local network.
mobilePrototype.expires: This pairing link and QR code expires in 24 hours and can be used once.
mobilePrototype.scanAgain: The pairing link is missing, expired or already used. Open a new link or scan a new QR code.
mobilePrototype.missingCode: The pairing code did not reach this page. Open the complete pairing link.
mobilePrototype.expiredCode: This pairing link has expired. Open a new link or scan a new QR code.
mobilePrototype.usedCode: This pairing link has already been used. Open the dashboard in the browser where you connected, or use a new link.
mobilePrototype.invalidCode: This pairing code is invalid. Open the complete pairing link.
mobilePrototype.readOnly: Phone access · read only · LAN prototype
mobilePrototype.networkError: The local connection is unavailable. Check the network permission and whether an installation is running.
mobilePrototype.joinHelp: Create a code on your first installation and paste it here on the additional computer within five minutes. The code grants access to this group: share it only with your own trusted installations. This prototype connects the mobile access group; desktop data synchronization is separate.
mobilePrototype.joinError: Invalid or expired installation code. Create a new code on the first installation.
mobilePrototype.directHelp: Tiešais QR kods apiet .local nosaukuma noteikšanu un paliek piesaistīts šim datoram. Tas neatļauj jaunu tīklu. Vispirms atļaujiet VPN privāto avotu: Iestatījumi → Tālrunis → Esošais VPN.
mobilePrototype.notificationsLan: Phone push is not set up on this HTTP address. Warnings appear while this page is open. A trusted HTTPS address is needed for lock-screen notifications.
mobilePrototype.notificationsConnectionHelp: Optional: notifications with the phone locked and access away from home
mobilePrototype.notificationsHelp: The Wi-Fi dashboard works without Tailscale. Phone push needs a trusted HTTPS address and a running computer with internet access. You can use your own domain and certificate, or optionally a private Tailscale HTTPS address. On iPhone, save that HTTPS address to the Home Screen, open its icon and allow notifications once. No dashboard relay is operated by us.
mobilePrototype.notificationsInstall: On iPhone, add this HTTPS dashboard to the Home Screen first and open it using that icon. Then tap Enable notifications.
mobilePrototype.notificationsInvite: Receive quota warnings and unexpected resets even with the dashboard closed. Enable notifications on this phone. The computer serving this HTTPS address must stay running and have Internet access.
mobilePrototype.notificationsActive: Push is registered for this phone. The computer serving this HTTPS address must stay running and have Internet access. Use a test notification to check reception.
mobilePrototype.notificationsDenied: Notifications are blocked for this web app. Allow them in the phone settings to enable push.
mobilePrototype.notificationsUnsupported: This browser does not support push here. Warnings still appear in the open dashboard.
mobilePrototype.notificationsError: Push could not be registered or sent. Check the connection and try again.
mobilePrototype.notificationsUnavailable: Warnings are currently unavailable. Check the connection to the running desktop app.
mobilePrototype.notificationsDesktopDisabled: Notifications are disabled in the desktop app. Enable them there to receive its warnings here.
mobilePrototype.notificationsEmpty: No current quota warnings or recently observed unexpected resets.
mobilePrototype.notificationsTestAccepted: The push service accepted the test. Check whether the notification arrived on your phone; acceptance does not confirm delivery.
mobilePrototype.notificationTestBody: Test from LLM Usage Dashboard. Quota warnings and unexpected resets will appear here.
mobilePrototype.notificationHardLimit: {provider} · {window}: {percent}% used. The limit is almost exhausted.
mobilePrototype.notificationPacing: {provider} · {window}: {percent}% used; at the current pace, {projected}% is projected before the reset.
mobilePrototype.notificationReset: {provider}: an early {window} reset was observed at {observed}. Previously scheduled for {time}. Now {percent}% used. Iepriekš izmantoti {previous}%.
mobilePrototype.notificationsWarningsOn: Dashboard warnings are on. Phone push is configured separately below.
mobilePrototype.notificationsResetsOff: Reset and quota-change notices are off in the desktop settings.
mobilePrototype.notificationResetScheduled: {provider}: {window} reset observed at {observed}. Previously scheduled for {time}. Now {percent}% used. Iepriekš izmantoti {previous}%.
mobilePrototype.notificationAvailable: {provider}: usage is available again for {window}, observed at {observed}. Previously scheduled reset: {time}. Now {percent}% used. Iepriekš izmantoti {previous}%.
mobilePrototype.notificationAdjusted: {provider}: {window} quota changed at {observed}: {previous}% → {percent}% used. Previously scheduled reset: {time}.
mobilePrototype.accessNetwork: Šis avota tīkls nav atļauts. Datorā atveriet Iestatījumi → Tālrunis → Esošais VPN un atļaujiet šauru privātu VPN avotu. Tiešais QR kods atrisina tikai nosaukumu noteikšanu.
mobilePrototype.accessNat: Šis /32 ieraksts atļauj novēroto avota adresi. Izmantojot NAT, tā var būt VPN vārtejas adrese, ko koplieto vairākas ierīces.
mobilePrototype.accessUnavailable: Nav pieejama privāta avota IPv4 adrese, kurai ieteikt atļaujas ierakstu.
mobilePrototype.accessHost: Šī adrese nav atļauta. Atveriet sākotnējo QR saiti no datora. Esošam VPN izmantojiet tiešo QR kodu.
mobilePrototype.accessOrigin: Šis pārlūka pieprasījums ir bloķēts. Atveriet sākotnējo savienošanas saiti tieši tālruņa pārlūkā un mēģiniet vēlreiz.

chatUsage.heading: Sarunas un pieteikumi
chatUsage.description: Lokālo žurnālu lietojums, grupēts pēc sarunas vai pieteikuma. Multica izpildes tiek skaitītas vienreiz.
chatUsage.apiNote: API ekvivalents, nevis rēķins vai abonēšanas maksa. Cenas {pricingDate}; valūtas kurss {fxDate}. Trūkstošās cenas paliek nezināmas.
chatUsage.reasoningNote: Kešatmiņas kategorijas ir atsevišķas. Spriešana jau ir iekļauta izvadē un netiek skaitīta divreiz.
chatUsage.multicaIncomplete: Multica piesaiste ir nepilnīga. Nepiesaistītās izpildes joprojām ir redzamas pie sākotnējā avota.

widget.title: Kontu kvotas
widget.empty: Kontu vēl nav. Pievienojiet kontu informācijas panelī.
widget.emptyFiltered: Nav atbilstošu kontu. Izvēlieties Visi vai citu pakalpojumu sniedzēju.
widget.wayland: Wayland: turiet logrīku augšpusē, izmantojot KDE loga izvēlni.
widget.error: Neizdevās atjaunināt. Saglabātie rādījumi var būt novecojuši.

plasma.title: KDE Plasma 6 logrīks
plasma.compactHelp: Atsevišķs lietotnes logs Linux, macOS un Windows sistēmām.
plasma.installHelp: Instalē tikai jūsu lietotājam. Ar labo peles pogu noklikšķiniet uz paneļa → Pievienot logrīkus → LLM Usage Dashboard, lai iegūtu kompaktu ikonu ar atveramu pārskatu. Darbvirsmā tiek rādīts lielais logrīks.
plasma.requirements: Nepieciešams Plasma 6, kpackagetool6, Python 3 un iekļautā logrīka pakotne.
plasma.unsupported: Vietējam logrīkam nepieciešams Linux ar Plasma 6. Šeit izmantojiet kompakto logu.
plasma.installError: Instalēšana neizdevās. Pārbaudiet Plasma 6 prasības un mēģiniet vēlreiz.
plasma.offline: Lietotne nav pieejama. Palaidiet darbvirsmas lietotni; iepriekšējie rādījumi ir novecojuši.
plasma.bounded: Ierobežots līdz {count}; izmantojiet izlasi vai pakalpojumu sniedzēja filtru.
plasma.reloadHelp: Šeit nevar pārbaudīt Plasma ielādēto versiju. Ja pēc atjaunināšanas paliek vecais skats, saglabājiet darbu, izrakstieties no Plasma un pierakstieties vēlreiz. Logrīka noņemšana un atkārtota pievienošana var izmantot veco kešatmiņā saglabāto skatu.

sync.title: Private device sync
sync.description: Automatically and idempotently sync normalized usage with a private collector.
sync.privacy: Only normalized token, model, time, and assignment data is transferred—never prompts, transcripts, raw logs, credentials, or local paths.
sync.disconnected: Sync connection and local credentials cleared.
sync.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this device and clear its local sync credentials and queue?
sync.fallbackLocal: Private sync is unavailable; showing local data. {message}
